Name: Plantman (Paul)
Description: Paul was a young adult who worked in a comic book shop, he was fired after his boss discovered Paul was stealing issues with variant covers, which he was selling to sustain his gaming hobby. Paul took notice of the Hench X App, and decided he could work as a super-villain mercenary, which he believed would certainly pay more than a minimum wage job. He also decided to take the opportunity to impress a girl he knew.
